summary.en-US: Encode, decode, hash and inspect selected text offline. Finds invisible, bidi and look-alike characters. Cybersecurity + Unicode.

description.en-US:
UniChef is a cybersecurity and Unicode workbench in your browser. Select text on any page, right-click and choose "Inspect with UniChef" to see every code point with its name, general category and script, with invisible and bidirectional control characters listed first: the tricks behind Trojan Source, homoglyph domains and hidden text.

The sidebar runs UniChef recipes: decode Base64, hex or URL encoding, hash with SHA-2, SHA-3 or BLAKE2, decrypt AES, decode a JWT, gunzip, normalise Unicode and more, chained step by step. It also has a character browser. Everything runs inside the extension: no text leaves your browser, nothing is collected and the extension asks for no access to the pages you visit.

Source code and issue tracker: https://github.com/0xdolan/unichef
